text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My first three years with Inari One have
come to a
close...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But the festival is far from over. Life
continues as
always.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The shimmering light and splendor of
the
fireworks she shot into the sky will
never be
forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And just like those fireworks, I have no
doubt
that the beats of her story will
resound in the
hearts of her fans
whenever they recall them.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Pardon me! Are you there, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Apologies! I've come to inform you of a
very
important and moderately urgent
matter!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Rejoice! This is a momentous occasion!
You have
been offered a position by an
American
Umamusume training
association!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa, whoa. What's the director doin'
comin' all
the way down here? Did
somethin' important
happen?)

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! They recognized your
accomplishments in
making Inari One
Umamusume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
While I believe this is an extremely rare

opportunity, the decision is ultimately in
your
hands!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However, the callback period is very
short! I
would appreciate a timely
response!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Time flies as I ponder over the sudden
offer...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, Boss! Hard at work as usual, eh?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, Boss! Hard at work as usual, eh?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Um... I wanted to talk to ya
about
somethin', but now that I'm here,
it's slipped my
mind...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Argh, to heck with it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I didn't mean to eavesdrop! I was passin'
by and
happened to overhear your
conversation with the
director!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I didn't mean to eavesdrop! I was passin'
by and
happened to overhear your
conversation with the
director!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And... I wanted to talk to ya about it.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Take that job in America.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's a rare opportunity, right? That's
somethin' to
celebrate! What better way
to spread your wings
and get a taste of
the world!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And if ya do well out there, that means I

personally trained with a globally
successful
trainer! Amazin', right?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And if ya do well out there, that means I

personally trained with a globally
successful
trainer! Amazin', right?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The folks back home won't believe this.
Chief
might just have a heart attack!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Man, I already knew you were one
talented
trainer, but this is on a
completely different—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Man, I already knew you were one
talented
trainer, but this is on a
completely different—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...It's not my place to stop ya.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You know... Chief saw me off when I
came to
Tracen.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
He gave me the courage to move
forward... so I
wanna do the same for
you.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That's... how I feel!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This situation is completely different
from her
saying goodbye to her coach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One truly wanted to compete in the
central
races. And Chief respected that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But my situation is different, because...
choice_data_list: I want to keep being Inari's Trainer longer.
I want to stay Inari's Trainer for much longer.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to walk side-by-side with Inari
One, as her
trainer. I want to take on
more challenges, start
more fights, and
put on more festivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's so much for the two of us to do.
So many
things to try. Our road hasn't
ended—far from it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So, despite receiving this offer to go to
America...
choice_data_list: If I can't go with you, Inari, I'm not going.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Boss...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Boss...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Resolute in my feelings, I tell her
everything that's
on my mind. As her
partner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Because you can't—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Put on a festival alone, right?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I couldn't help myself. It had to
be said
with style!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Let's start this thing over, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Let's start this thing over, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The biggest, rowdiest road is just ahead,
waitin'
for us to see what lies beyond!
